scope: Reference-only packet. The numeric prototype is unbuilt and this API remains upstream-only.

proposed_numeric_scope.input: Plain native-endian C-contiguous naturally aligned 2D uint8, float32, or float64 ndarray with bounded backing and both extents at least two, and at most 4194304 elements.
proposed_numeric_scope.scalars: Exact Python int n in [1,16] and finite exact Python float threshold in [0,256].
proposed_numeric_scope.precision: Round-to-nearest; uint8 is scaled by binary64 reciprocal times level. Floating inputs are finite in [-256,256]. Float32 keeps float32 boundary and response operations.
proposed_numeric_scope.order: Strict bright/dark comparisons and circular run; four cardinal samples for n>=12; on acceptance score all 16 samples in clockwise order from the positive column direction.
proposed_numeric_scope.output: Same shape with radius-three zero border. Writable ndarray with a memoryview base; uint8 and float64 return float64, float32 returns float32.
proposed_numeric_scope.normal_and_forced_scalar: The same serial numeric leaf is proposed in both process modes.
proposed_numeric_scope.compatibility: Other values, protocols, shapes and layouts retain fallback; float32 and float64 require writable input, as the original memoryview consumer does.

observed_parity_blocker.stock: result.base.obj is the live skimage.feature.corner_cy._memoryviewslice and its .base is the owning numpy.ndarray.
observed_parity_blocker.prototype: A NumPy-backed memoryview exposes the owning ndarray directly as result.base.obj.
observed_parity_blocker.scope: Observable difference also occurs on the ordinary 7x7 uint8 case in both retained stock profiles. The original type is private and is not exported as a module attribute.
observed_parity_blocker.disposition: Exact native public ownership, hot-swap and release admission remain pending.

timing.boundary: Whole public call including response allocation, output wrapping and uint8 normalization.
